variants.title: A · 토이 캠프
variants.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: a polished, production-quality mobile casual fantasy game LOBBY screenshot concept, a SINGLE full-bleed portrait screen, approximately 9:16 aspect ratio (1080x1920 if possible). Flat front-on orthographic UI view; NO phone frame, NO device mockup, NO annotations or presentation title outside the game.
Reference image role: the attached current TRIO CHESS lobby is ONLY a reference for existing character identities and game features. Redesign the entire layout and improve the polish dramatically; do not preserve its clutter, thick text outlines, oversized title or button placement.
Game identity: exactly THREE friendly toy-like 3D chibi heroes in a party: a stocky white-bearded warrior with silver horned helmet, orange tunic, sword and small round shield; a pink-haired ranger with green tunic, brown boots and a bow; a mage wearing purple pointed hat, blue robe and carrying a crystal-tipped staff. Clear simple faces, chunky stylized silhouettes, rounded matte toy materials, highly professional casual mobile rendering with soft ambient occlusion and warm light. Original characters, not copied characters from another game.
Research direction: adopt clear action hierarchy and tactile readable UI from contemporary polished mobile casual games, simplified 3D objects and clean color blocks. A disciplined limited palette, restrained dark navy/teal outlines, small drop shadows, crisp rounded Korean sans-serif with a few bold display headings. No ornamental fantasy metal frames, no gritty textures, no glassmorphism, no neon, no heavy stroke on every text. UI should look actually playable, not a painterly poster.
Existing feature constraints: only gold, enhancement stones, time crystals; quest, attendance, camp idle reward, equipment, relics, challenge (raid/endless), talent growth and expedition. Do not invent energy, VIP, shop, clan, battle pass, chat, paid packs, player profile or PvP. Notification red dots in at most TWO places. Settings top right. All controls aligned to consistent margins and spacing; generous whitespace and large mobile touch targets.
Exact shared UI text where used: small brand "TRIO CHESS"; resource chips coin "47,769", blue stone "986", purple crystal "1,698"; shortcuts "미션" and "출석"; yellow main button "출발"; current chapter "1. 햇살 왕국"; objective "10무리 돌파"; "장비", "유물", "도전", "성장", "원정", "끝없는 행군". Render Korean correctly and cleanly. Do not print these directions on the image.
Only ONE visually dominant yellow primary action. No duplicate start buttons, no overflowing text, no overlapping controls, no debug/UI preset/Esc text. Hero art must be as strong as the UI.
Distinct layout A: CAMP DIORAMA / HERO-FIRST. Make this a premium, bright, charming mobile lobby with a large scenic 3D toy camp in the MIDDLE and a compact action sheet at the bottom.
Precise vertical structure: top 0-14% small brand at upper left, gear icon upper right, below a SINGLE neat horizontal row of three dark teal currency capsules with big readable pictograms. Center 14-64% an expansive sky blue backdrop, subtle distant soft hills and a soft grass island carrying the three large hero figures, warrior left, pink-haired ranger center, mage right, all full bodies visible, camera low enough to see their faces. A pine tree left, small purple-crystal outcrop right and tiny warm campfire front. Heroes together occupy about 30% of screen height, island spacious and airy; less scenery than characters. Only TWO small square utility buttons at right edge below resources, quest clipboard "미션", attendance calendar "출석"; no left toolbar. A small chest beside the campfire has a tidy cream label "보상 받기" and a single red dot. No other floating text on art.
Bottom 64-90% warm ivory rounded-top sheet: small turquoise category pill "원정", below a single clean chapter selector row with left chevron, "1. 햇살 왕국", right chevron. Small muted objective "10무리 돌파". Large full-width sunny yellow pill-shaped tactile "출발" button with a tiny forward triangle, shallow orange base. Under it one slim quiet secondary line "끝없는 행군  ›" in teal; no second giant mode card.
Bottom 91-100% an evenly spaced five-item permanent rounded navigation bar in cream: sword/shield "장비", purple relic "유물", raised campfire selected "캠프", crossed swords "도전", sprouting talent tree "성장". Selected center camp has subtle teal backing, the other icons muted. The equipment icon can have the second and last red dot.
Color direction: turquoise #32BDAE, clear sky blue #BCEAF4, butter yellow #FFD34D, warm ivory #FFF8E8, dark teal #19484C, restrained orange and lavender accents. Sophisticated simple casual UI with no dark enclosing border. Make the scene feel like a game opened to a friendly home, not a standalone illustration.
